Name: Fishing Made Easy Suite (Content Patcher)
Author: Ericlegacy21
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/W8oBuzB.png[/img]

[color=#a4c2f4][size=4][b][u][i]Supported for Stardew Valley v1.6[/i][/u][/b][/size][/color]

[left][size=3][b]Upgrade your fishing adventure! [/b]Tweak difficulty (easy/hard), fish availability (time, seasons, weather), spawn rates, and sell value. Remove trash, recatch legendary fish, fish Prismatic Shards, boost Fish Pond loot, exclude specific fish from the minigame, and much more! Dive into the ultimate fishing experience. Happy Fishing! :D

[b][u]See "List of Settings"[/u][/b] below to view all the options and features included with the mod!

[b][u]Translations are welcome![/u][/b]
If you or know of someone that would like to translate this mod, please release the translation that adds a i18n folder and link it back to this mod! 
[url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Translations]Modding:Translations - Stardew Valley Wiki[/url]

[b][u]New to modding?[/u][/b]
Check out this modding guide for additional help and resources: 
[url=https://www.stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started]Modding:Player Guide/Getting Started - Stardew Valley Wiki[/url][/size]

[size=3][color=#ffff00][b]1.[/b][/color] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]Download and Install the Latest Version of SMAPI.[/url]﻿﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400][/url]

[color=#ffff00][b]2.[/b][/color] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Download and Extract the Content Patcher mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/url]

[color=#ffff00][b]3.[/b][/color] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Download and Extract the Generic Mod Config Menu mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.﻿

[/url][color=#ffff00][b]4.[/b][/color] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3623?tab=files]Download and Extract the Fishing Made Easy Suite mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/url]﻿﻿﻿

[color=#ffff00][b]5.[/b] [/color][color=#f4f4f4]Launch Stardew Valley.[/color][color=#ffff00] [/color]To enable the settings you want, click the cog wheel on the bottom left of the Stardew Valley title screen. All the settings will be there. Hover over the settings for full descriptions.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/hv28Y8r.jpg[/img]

[b][color=#ffff00][u]IMPORTANT[/u]:[/color] [/b][color=#f4f4f4]If you do not want the fishing minigame but want all the features that come with Fishing Made Easy Suite, this mod is also fully compatible with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2697]Skip Fishing Minigame﻿[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20391]Yet Another Fishing Mod[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4756]FishMe[/url] mods﻿![/color][/size]

[size=3][b][u]If you're using Steam:[/u][/b][i] You can easily find your mods folder by going into your Steam Library, right click on Stardew Valley, click 'Manage', then 'Browse local files'. This will take you to your Stardew Valley directory that will have the mods folder there. That is where you will extract the contents of your mods.[/i][/size]

[size=3]Here's the list of settings included with Fishing Made Easy Suite![/size]

[u][i][size=3]Click the spoiler button for the full list of settings:[/size]

[/i][/u]
[spoiler]
[b][color=#a4c2f4][size=4][u]FISHING MINIGAME[/u][/size][/color][/b]

[size=3][b][u]Fishing Difficulty[/u][/b]
-Will modify fishing difficulty. Ranges from 5% up to 100% for easy settings, and include a super easy option to max out the green fishing bar. Other options include 10% to 50% for easy Sunday fishing which will make fishing easier only on Sundays, 5% to 100% for harder settings as well as a NIGHTMARE setting for those seeking the ultimate challenge!

[b][u]Randomized Difficulty[/u][/b]
-When the Fishing Difficulty setting is active, the difficulty of catching fish will vary within the chosen range. For example, setting the difficulty to 25% Easier means each day, fish will be between 0% and 25% easier to catch. One day, they might be 17% easier, and the next day, 23% easier. This setting is compatible with the Easy, Easy Sunday, and Hard Fishing Difficulty options. However, it does NOT work with the Super Easy, NIGHTMARE, and Dynamic Weather options.

[b][u]All Times Of Day[/u][/b]
-All fish can now be caught at any time of day.

[b][u]All Types Of Weather[/u][/b]
-All fish, except legendary fish, can now be caught in all types of weather.

[b][u]All Seasons[/u][/b]
-All fish, except legendary fish, can now be caught in every season.

[b][u]Same Spawn Rates[/u][/b]
-All fish, except legendary fish, now share the same spawn rates.

[b][color=#a4c2f4][size=4][u]FISH AVAILABILITY[/u][/size][/color][/b]

[b][u]Cave/Mine Fish Availability[/u][/b]
-The rare cave and mine fish; Stonefish, Ice Pip, and Lava Eel are now available in specific locations. Must be Fishing Level 5. Stonefish; Mountain, Ice Pip; Forest Lake, Lava Eel; Desert. Choose a spawn rate for the fish.

[b][u]Night Market Fish Availability[/u][/b]
-The Night Market Fish (Midnight Squid, Spook Fish, and Blobfish) will now be fishable anywhere on the Beach during Winter after 5pm. Must be Fishing level 5. The All Times Of Day and All Seasons settings will also have an effect on these fish.

[size=3][u][b]Fishable Prize Tickets[/b][/u][/size]
[size=3]-Prize Tickets are now a fishable item. Similar to Seaweed and Algae (No minigame). You can choose the spawn rate ranging from 1% to 100% chance.

[b][color=#a4c2f4][size=4][u]CLEAN WATERS[/u][/size][/color][/b][/size]

[b][u]Clean Waters/No Trash[/u][/b]
-Will determine the spawn rate of trash items while fishing. The No Trash option will disable trash altogether. The Crab Pot Fish option will replace all trash items with crab pot fish while fishing. There will be some occurrences where trash will still spawn at times. Trash is considered a failback if no fish spawn. But these settings will significantly reduce the chances of trash items spawning.

[b][u]Clean Waters/No Weeds[/u][/b]
-Will determine the spawn rate of Seaweed, Green Algae, and White Algae while fishing. The No Weeds and Algae option will disable all weeds and algae altogether. The Crab Pot Fish option will replace all seaweed and alae with crab pot fish while fishing.

[b][color=#a4c2f4][size=4][u]FISHING RODS[/u][/size][/color][/b]

[u][b]Iridium Rod Attach. Slots[/b][/u][/size]
[size=3]-Select how many attachment slots are available on the Iridium Rod. This will allow you to stack bobber and lure effects.

[size=3][u][b]Adv. Iridium Rod Attach. Slots[/b][/u][/size]
[size=3]-Select how many attachment slots are available on the Advanced Iridium Rod. This will allow you to stack bobber and lure effects.[/size][/size]

[b][color=#a4c2f4][size=4][u]CRAB POT FISHING

[/u][/size][/color][/b][size=3][u][b]Crab Pots Same Spawn Rates[/b][/u][/size]
[size=3]-Crab Pot fish will now all share the same spawn rates.[/size]

[size=3][b][u]Crab Pots No Trash[/u][/b]
-Crab Pots will no longer produce trash items.

[b][u]Crab Pots Jellies[/u][/b]
-Crab Pots now spawn Jellies. This includes River, Sea, and Cave Jellies.

[b][u]Crab Pots Bug Meat[/u][/b]
-Crab Pots now have a chance to spawn Bug Meat. Choose whether they can spawn in freshwater (rivers and lakes) or the ocean (beach).

[size=3][b][color=#a4c2f4][size=4][u]JELLY FISHING[/u][/size][/color][/b][/size]

[b][u]Jelly Spawn Rates[/u][/b]
-Select a setting to determine the spawn rates of all jellies while fishing. Ranges from a 1% to 50% chance or remove jellies altogether. The Default 10% chance has them in the same pool as normal fish so they're more rare than stated. Selecting 10% in the options will be a 'true' 10% chance to spawn jellies instead of using the default method. All other spawn settings will also put the jellies in their own spawn pool. Using this setting also removes the luck chance boost.

[b][u]Cave Jelly Desert[/u][/b]
-Cave Jelly will now spawn in the Desert fishing area. Replaces the River Jelly that would normally spawn in that location.

[b][u]Jellies Are Crab Pot Fish[/u][/b]
-All jellies will now be any crab pot fish when fished up. This has no effect on the Cave Jelly Desert setting.[/size]

[b][color=#a4c2f4][size=4][u]VALUE OF FISHING[/u][/size][/color][/b]

[size=3][b][u]Fish Sell Value[/u][/b]
-Will increase the sell value of all fish, except for legendary fish. Ranges from 10% to 1000% increase. Use the setting below for Legendary Fish Sell Values. Please note, enabling or disabling these settings will only pertain to newly acquired fish after the setting you want is enabled!

[b][u]Legendary Fish Sell Value[/u][/b]
-Will increase or decrease the sell value of all legendary fish. The increase options ranges from 10% to 1000%. The decrease options ranges from 10% to 99%. Please note, enabling or disabling these settings will only pertain to newly acquired legendary fish after the setting you want is enabled![/size]

[color=#a4c2f4][size=4][b][u]FARMLAND FISHING[/u][/b][/size][/color]

[size=3][b][u]Seasonal Fish On Farm[/u][/b]
-Seasonal Fish can now be caught on the on the farm. Applies to all farm maps.

[b][u]Specialty Fish On Farm[/u][/b]
-Specialty Fish can now be caught on the farm. Applies to all farm maps.

[b][u]Legendary Fish On Farm[/u][/b]
-Legendary Fish can now be caught on the farm. Applies to all farm maps. Only one legendary fish can be caught on a farm map unless you enable the 'Recatch Legendary Fish' option which will allow you to catch more than one.[/size]

[color=#a4c2f4][size=4][b][u]LEGENDARY FISHING[/u][/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]
[b][u]Recatch Legendary Fish[/u][/b]
-Legendary fish can now be caught multiple times.

[b][u]Legendary Quests (Recatch REQ)[/u][/b]
-New quests for legendary fish will now be available. The Recatch Legendary Fish setting is required for this setting to work.

[b][u]Entire Area Legendary Fish[/u][/b]
-Legendary fish can now be caught anywhere in their residing area and not limited to a specific point on a map. For example, the Crimsonfish can now be caught anywhere around the beach, not just at the eastern docks.

[b][u]Legendary Fish Spawn Rates[/u][/b]
-Select the chance of legendary fish spawning while fishing. Ranges from 1% to 50% chance.

[b][u]Legendary Fish No Level[/u][/b]
-Removes the level requirement in order for legendary fish to spawn.

[b][u]Legendary Fish No Crown[/u][/b]
-Legendary fish will no longer have the crown (Boss Fish) icon during the fishing minigame. This will also lower the xp to a standard fish rate.

[b][u]Qi's Legendary Fish Crown[/u][/b]
-The Legendary Fish that spawn during Qi's Special Order Request will now have the crown (Boss Fish) icon during the fishing minigame.

[b][u]All Weather Legendary Fish[/u][/b]
-Legendary fish can now be caught in all types of weather.

[b][u]All Seasons Legendary Fish[/u][/b]
-Legendary fish can now be caught in every season.

[b][u]Lucky Legendary Fish[/u][/b]
-Legendary fish now only spawn when daily luck from the TV is at its highest.

[b][u]Curious Legendary Fish
[/u][/b]-Increase the Curiosity Lure buff for Legendary Fish. Ranges from 10% to 100%.

[b][u]Legendary Fish Gifts[/u][/b]
-Legendary fish are now a universally loved gift for all the villagers.

[b][u]Legendary Fish 7am To 9am[/u][/b]
-Legendary fish are now only available during the hours of 7am to 9am. Can combine with the other time settings.

[b][u]Legendary Fish 12pm To 2pm[/u][/b]
-Legendary fish are now only available during the hours of 12pm to 2pm. Can combine with the other time settings.

[b][u]Legendary Fish 11pm To 1am[/u][/b]
-Legendary fish are now only available during the hours of 11pm to 1am. Can combine with the other time settings.

[color=#a4c2f4][size=4][b][u]PRISMATIC SHARD FISHING[/u][/b][/size][/color]

[size=3][b][u]Fishable Prismatic Shards (REQ)[/u][/b]
-Prismatic Shards are now available for fishing and can be caught in most locations upon reaching Fishing Level 5. This setting will also give the ability to place Prismatic Shards in fish tanks! This setting is essential for configuring most of the Prismatic Shard settings below!

[b][u]Prismatic Shard Spawn Rate[/u][/b]
-Choose a setting that will modify the spawn rate of fishable Prismatic Shards. Requires the Fishable Prismatic Shards (REQ) setting to work!

[b][u]Prismatic Shards No Level[/u][/b]
-Removes the fishing level 5 requirement in order for Prismatic Shards to spawn. Requires the Fishable Prismatic Shards (REQ) setting to work!

[b][u]Prismatic Shards No Crown[/u][/b]
-Prismatic Shards will no longer have the legendary fish (crown) icon during the fishing minigame. This will allow lower the amount of fishing xp earned when catching a shard. Please note that the Fishable Prismatic Shards (REQ) setting must be enabled for this to take effect!

[b][u]Prismatic Shard Sell Value[/u][/b]
-Set the sell value of Prismatic Shards. Default is 2000g. Ranges from 1750g to 1g. Does not require any other Prismatic Shard setting to work! Scroll down to see more options.

[b][u]Lucky Prismatic Shards[/u][/b]
-Prismatic Shards spawn rate changes based on daily luck from the TV. Requires the Fishable Prismatic Shards (REQ) setting to work!

[b][u]Prismatic Shards Weather[/u][/b]
-Prismatic Shards can now only be caught during rainy and snowy weather. Requires the Fishable Prismatic Shards (REQ) setting to work!

[b][u]Prismatic Shards 7am To 9am[/u][/b]
-Prismatic Shards can now only be caught during the hours of 7am to 9am. Can combine with the other time settings. Requires the Fishable Prismatic Shards (REQ) setting to work!

[b][u]Prismatic Shards 12pm To 2pm[/u][/b]
-Prismatic Shards can now only be caught during the hours of 12pm to 2pm. Can combine with the other time settings. Requires the Fishable Prismatic Shards (REQ) setting to work!

[b][u]Prismatic Shards 11pm To 1am[/u][/b]
-Prismatic Shards can now only be caught during the hours of 11pm to 1am. Can combine with the other time settings. Requires the Fishable Prismatic Shards (REQ) setting to work![/size][/size]

[color=#a4c2f4][size=4][b][u]FISH POND BUILDINGS[/u][/b][/size][/color]

[size=3][b][u]Fish Pond Rare Loot[/u][/b]
-Will increase the chance for rare loot to spawn from the Fish Pond Building every morning. Settings range from 1.5X to 5X as an increase. Alternatively, the All Rare Loot 1 to 50% Chance option ensures an equal chance for all rare loot from fish ponds to appear.

[b][u]FP Fish/Quest Spawn Time[/u][/b]
-Will reduce the rate in which fish in the fish ponds buildings replicate and when new fish pond quests appear. These options will only work on newly built fish ponds after you enable the setting you want.

[b][u]Fish Pond Legendary Fish (REQ)[/u][/b]
-Legendary fish will now have a variety of loot from fish pond buildings rather than just being roe. This setting is required for the legendary fish pond settings below!

[b][u]Legendary Fish Pond Loot[/u][/b]
-Will increase the chance for legendary fish rare loot to spawn from the Fish Pond Building every morning. Settings range from 1.5X to 5X as an increase. Alternatively, the All Rare Loot 1 to 50% Chance option ensures an equal chance for all rare loot from fish ponds to appear. Requires the Fish Pond Legendary Fish (REQ) setting to work!

[b][u]LG Fish/Quest Spawn Time[/u][/b]
-Will reduce the rate in which legendary fish in the fish ponds buildings replicate and when new fish pond quests appear. Requires the Fish Pond Legendary Fish (REQ) setting to work! These options will only work on newly built fish ponds after you enable the setting you want.

[b][u]Fish Pond Prismatic Shards[/u][/b]
-All fish pond buildings now have a chance to spawn Prismatic Shards when fish ponds are full.[/size]

[color=#a4c2f4][size=4][b][u]FISHING TACKLE AND LURES[/u][/b][/size][/color]

[size=3][b][u]Tackle Materials[/u][/b]
-Will decrease the amount of materials required to craft tackle and lures.

[b][u]Tackle Fishing Level 1[/u][/b]
-All tackle can now be learned at Fishing Level 1.

[b][u]Craftable Curiosity Lure[/u][/b]
-The Curiosity Lure can now be crafted and learned at either Fishing Level 9 or Level 1. This lure increases the chance for rare fish to spawn.

[b][u]Curiosity Lure Materials[/u][/b]
-will decrease the amount of materials required to craft the Curiosity Lure. Requires the Craftable Curiosity Lure setting to work![/size]

[color=#a4c2f4][size=4][u][b]FISHING FOR FOOD AND INGREDIENTS[/b][/u][/size][/color]

[size=3]This section has options to give all food items that give a buff to fishing an infinite duration for the day, increase the fishing buff stats up to +50, and the ability to decrease the required ingredients to cook the fishing food items.[/size]

[color=#a4c2f4][size=4][b][u]WORM BIN MACHINERY[/u][/b][/size][/color]

[size=3][b][u]Worm Bin Materials[/u][/b]
-Will decrease the amount of materials required to craft the Worm Bin machine.

[b][u]Worm Bin Level Availability[/u][/b]
-Choose the fishing level in which you can learn the Worm Bin crafting recipe.

[b][u]Worm Bin Bait Min Amount[/u][/b]
-Choose the minimum amount of bait that can be produced daily from the Worm Bin. Ranges from 2 to 100.

[b][u]Worm Bin Bait Max Amount[/u][/b]
-Choose the maximum amount of bait that can be produced daily from the Worm Bin. Ranges from 5 to 100.

[b][u]Worm Bin Wild Bait (REQ)[/u][/b]
-Worm Bins now have a small chance to produce Wild Bait. This setting is required for the Wild Bait settings below!

[b][u]Worm Bin Wild Bait Chance[/u][/b]
-Choose the chances of Wild Bait producing daily from the Worm Bin. Ranges from 15% to 100% chance. Requires the Worm Bin Chance For Wild Bait (REQ) setting to work!

[b][u]Worm Bin Wild Bait Min Amount[/u][/b]
-Choose the minimum amount of Wild Bait that can be produced daily from the Worm Bin. Ranges from 2 to 100. Requires the Worm Bin Chance For Wild Bait (REQ) setting to work!

[b][u]Worm Bin Wild Bait Max Amount[/u][/b]
-Choose the maximum amount of Wild Bait that can be produced daily from the Worm Bin. Ranges from 5 to 100. Requires the Worm Bin Chance For Wild Bait (REQ) setting to work!

[b][u]Wild Bait Crafting Materials[/u][/b]
-Choose a setting that will decrease the amount of materials required to craft Wild Bait.

[color=#a4c2f4][size=4][b][u]DELUXE WORM BIN MACHINERY[/u][/b][/size][/color]

[size=3][b][u]Deluxe Worm Bin Materials[/u][/b]
-Will decrease the amount of materials required to craft the Worm Bin machine.

[b][u][b][u]Deluxe [/u][/b]Worm Bin Level Availability[/u][/b]
-Choose the fishing level in which you can learn the Worm Bin crafting recipe.

[b][u]Deluxe Worm Bin Bait Min Amount[/u][/b]
-Choose the minimum amount of bait that can be produced daily from the Worm Bin. Ranges from 2 to 100.

[b][u]Deluxe Worm Bin Bait Max Amount[/u][/b]
-Choose the maximum amount of bait that can be produced daily from the Worm Bin. Ranges from 5 to 100.

[b][u]Deluxe Worm Bin Wild Bait (REQ)[/u][/b]
-Worm Bins now have a small chance to produce Wild Bait. This setting is required for the Wild Bait settings below!

[b][u]Deluxe Worm Bin Wild Bait Chance[/u][/b]
-Choose the chances of Wild Bait producing daily from the Worm Bin. Ranges from 15% to 100% chance. Requires the Worm Bin Chance For Wild Bait (REQ) setting to work!

[b][u]Deluxe Worm Bin Wild Bait Min Amount[/u][/b]
-Choose the minimum amount of Wild Bait that can be produced daily from the Worm Bin. Ranges from 2 to 100. Requires the Worm Bin Chance For Wild Bait (REQ) setting to work!

[b][u]Deluxe Worm Bin Wild Bait Max Amount[/u][/b]
-Choose the maximum amount of Wild Bait that can be produced daily from the Worm Bin. Ranges from 5 to 100. Requires the Worm Bin Chance For Wild Bait (REQ) setting to work!

[b][u]Deluxe Wild Bait Crafting Materials[/u][/b]
-Choose a setting that will decrease the amount of materials required to craft Wild Bait.[/size][/size]

[color=#a4c2f4][size=4][b][u]RECYCLING MACHINE[/u][/b][/size][/color]

[size=3][b][u]Recycling Machine Faster[/u][/b]
-Choose a setting that will decrease the amount of time it takes for Recycling Machines to finish production. Ranges from 50 minutes to 10 minutes.

[b][u]Recycling Machine Materials[/u][/b]
-Choose a setting that will decrease the amount of materials required to craft Recycling Machines.

[b][u]Recycling Machine Level Availability[/u][/b]
-Choose the fishing level in which you can learn the Recycling Machine crafting recipe.

[u][b]Recycling Machine Produce Min[/b][/u]
-Select the minimum production of materials from the Recycling Machine, all items by default have different ranges.

[u][b]Recycling Machine Produce Max[/b][/u]
-Select the maximum production of materials from the Recycling Machine, all items by default have different ranges.

[u][b]Recycling Machine Required Mats.[/b][/u]
-Select the amount of items required to be placed inside the Recycling Machine.

[b][u]Recycling Machine Tackle[/u][/b]
-Recycling Machines will now have a chance to produce fishing tackle from all trash items.

[b][u]Recycling Prismatic Shards[/u][/b]
-Recycling Machines now have a small chance to produce a Prismatic Shard from trash items.

[color=#a4c2f4][size=4][b][u]FISH SMOKER MACHINERY[/u][/b][/size][/color]

[size=3][b][u]Fish Smoker Faster[/u][/b]
-Choose a setting that will decrease the amount of time it takes for Fish Smokers to finish production. Ranges from 40 minutes to 10 minutes.

[b][u]Fish Smoker Materials[/u][/b]
-Choose a setting that will decrease the amount of materials required to craft Recycling Machines.

[b][u]Fish Smoker No Coal[/u][/b]
-Fish Smokers will no longer require coal to produce smoked fish.

[b][u]Fish Smoker Quality[/u][/b]
-Select the quality of smoked fish produced from the Fish Smoker.

[u][b]Fish Smoker Produce Min[/b][/u]
-Select the minimum production of smoked fish from the Recycling Machine, all items by default have different ranges.

[u][b]Fish Smoker Produce Max[/b][/u]
-Select the maximum production of smoked fish from the Recycling Machine, all items by default have different ranges.

[u][b]Fish Smoker Required Mats.[/b][/u]
-Select the amount of fish required to be placed inside the Recycling Machine.

[color=#a4c2f4][size=4][b][u]BAIT MAKER MACHINERY[/u][/b][/size][/color][size=3]

[b][u]Bait Maker Materials[/u][/b]
-Choose a setting that will decrease the amount of materials required to craft Bait Makers.

[u][b]Bait Maker Produce Min[/b][/u]
-Select the minimum production of bait from the Bait Maker, all items by default have different ranges.

[u][b]Bait Maker Produce Max[/b][/u]
-Select the maximum production of bait from the Bait Maker, all items by default have different ranges.

[b][color=#a4c2f4][size=4][u]FISHING MINIGAME EXCLUSIONS

[/u][/size][/color][/b][size=3]This category includes settings which you can exclude individual fish from spawning during the fishing minigame.

Each fish you exclude will set their catch limit to 1 which will allow you to still obtain the fishing achievements.[/size][/spoiler]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/866?tab=description]
[/url][color=#6d9eeb][size=4][b][img]https://i.imgur.com/kguGL3f.png[/img]

[/b][/size][/color][size=3]Have problems with Fishing Made Easy Suite? Click this spoiler button to view frequently asked questions. If you have any additional issues not posted here please let me know! Thanks :)[/size]

[spoiler]
[color=#00ff00][size=3]Q: What happened to all the mod expansions from pre-7.0.0?[/size][/color]

[size=3]A: All mod expansions are now merged and included in the base Fishing Made Easy Suite mod as of Version 7.0.0! You will no longer need to download separate mods to work with specific mods. Only certain mods are supported at this time. Check the Mod Expansions section on the mod page or the INSTRUCTIONS & INFO document included with Fishing Made Easy Suite to see which mods are supported. You can post your suggestions for future compatibilities on the mod page![/size]

[color=#00ff00][size=3]Q: Where are the fish exclusions in the mod settings?[/size][/color]

[size=3]A: Fish exclusions are now their own mods found under the Files tab in the Optional section as of Version 7.0.0. Each expansion and the base game have their own mod with their own settings menu![/size]

[size=3][color=#00ff00]Q: I came from the Easy Fishing v2.0 mod to this one and I'm getting errors in SMAPI saying I'm missing data...?[/color]

A: If this happens you need to revalidate your Stardew Valley installation files. To do so, right click on Stardew Valley on Steam. Click on Properties. Then on the left side on the new window, click on Local Files. Then click on the option Verify Integrity of Game Files. This will restore the xnb file that was used by the Easy Fishing v2.0 mod back to the original. Then Fishing Made Easy Suite will work properly.

[color=#00ff00]Q: I'm getting less fishing xp with the mod enabled...why's that?[/color]

A: This may seem worrisome, but don't worry! Fishing xp is awarded based on the difficulty of the fish, you'll still get a good amount of xp in a good amount of time with the 100% setting. It could be a little slower or a little faster than not having the mod installed.

(Example: At 100% easy fishing, most fish will grant 14 to 21+ xp per perfect catch.)

If you want max xp while using 100% easy fishing, switch to the "100% Easier + Max Fishing Bar" setting instead. This will guarantee fishing chests and full xp!

[color=#00ff00]Q: Is there a way to completely skip the fishing mini game and still use the Fishing Made Easy Suite settings like recatching legendary fish?[/color]

A: Yes! The mod Skip Fishing Minigame and FishMe are compatible! CJB Cheats Menu's fishing options also work well!.

[color=#00ff00]Q: Is this mod compatible or not compatible with other fishing mods?[/color]

A: As of Stardew Valley v1.6, most fishing mods should be compatible with Fishing Made Easy Suite! Check the mod compatibility section for more information on mods that are not compatible.

[color=#00ff00]Q: Does this mod work on Android devices?[/color]

A: Yes! But the app needs to be on the latest release for the mod to work.

[color=#00ff00]Q: Does this mod work in multiplayer?[/color]

A: Yes! It will work for those that have the mod installed. BUT settings that make fish appear at in all seasons or make legendary fish recatchable will not work unless the host has the mod and enables it. This is because those settings affect the game's location data. But any other setting that affects Easy Fishing, Time, and Weather will work for just those people that have them enabled.

[color=#00ff00]Q: Will Fishing Made Easy work with other languages (German, French, Spanish, etc) of the game?[/color]

A: Yes it will! The Content Patcher mod that is required to make Fishing Made Easy work makes this possible. :)[/size][/spoiler]
